# Ruqyah Healing — AI Context

## What We Are
Ruqyah Healing Center provides Islamic spiritual healing services (ruqyah) based on Quran and Sunnah. We serve patients across Bangladesh, offering diagnosis, treatment, and self-ruqyah guidance.

**Website:** https://ruqyahhealing.com
**Email:** info@ruqyahhealing.com
**Phone:** +8801992575874
**Location:** Dhaka, Bangladesh

## Our Services
- Ruqyah Diagnosis — Spiritual assessment to identify afflictions
- Ruqyah Treatment — Quranic recitation and adhkar for spiritual healing
- Hijama (Cupping) Therapy — Sunnah-compliant blood cupping
- Self-Ruqyah Guidance — Training for independent daily protection
- Ruqyah Supplements — Spiritual wellness products

## Our Focus Areas
- Jinn possession and spiritual affliction
- Evil eye (hasad/nazar)
- Black magic (sihr)
- Waswasa (intrusive whispers)
- Mental health with spiritual dimensions
- Marital problems with spiritual causes
- Children's spiritual issues
- General spiritual protection
